summary: Maxeon Solar Technologies, Ltd. (Under Judicial Management) filed a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026 disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq delisting determination. Nasdaq staff announced on September 17, 2026 its decision to delist Maxeon's ordinary shares from the Nasdaq Global Market, following prior suspension at the open on May 1, 2026 and migration to the over-the-counter market. Nasdaq will file a Form 25 Notification of Delisting with the SEC, expected effective ten days after filing. No price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms were disclosed. Watch OTC liquidity, judicial-management asset-sale or liquidation developments, and any last-minute appeal or Form 25 timing risk.
